results.source_quote: To qualify, the applicant must be a resident farmer of Maharashtra, registered under PM-KISAN, and possess valid land records (7/12 extract) in the state.
The Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN) is a central government scheme launched in 2019 to provide income support to all landholding farmer families across India.
Beneficiary family should not own a pucca house anywhere in India
Woman resident of Maharashtra; Age between 21 and 65 years; Annual family income not exceeding Rs 2.5 lakh
